title: The Hermit's Tradition
subtitle: The last gift
text: Harbinger Hermits are Hemomancers who have grown old and know their time is short. Rather than retire quietly, they undertake one final sacred act — they travel alone to a remote place and create a Mortal Display: a ritual pedestal on which they remove their own heart. While their heart beats on the pedestal, the Hermit waits in a state of suspended mortality, unable to die, unable to wander far. They wait for someone worthy to come along and take what was always meant to be given.
